main.description: Looks up one indexed collection by exact AT-URI. Hydrates its author and exact-version location and tag sibling projections; the original collection record remains unchanged. Missing related target versions are null without hiding the collection. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full collection record AT-URI using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a collection record AT-URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed collection exists at this AT-URI.

collectionProfileView.description: Profile record view used in collection author projections; indexedAt is required and may be null when the index has no timestamp.

collectionOrganizationView.description: Organization sidecar view used in collection author projections; indexedAt is required and may be null when the index has no timestamp.

collectionActorView.description: Collection author DID with nullable profile and organization sidecar views whose indexedAt values may be null.

locationRecordView.description: Raw location record view with metadata and no author hydration, used for exact-version collection reference projections.

vocabTagRecordView.description: Raw vocabulary-tag record view with metadata and no author hydration, used for exact-version collection reference projections.

collectionLocationView.description: Original strong-reference URI and CID plus the exact referenced location record view, or null when that version is unavailable.

collectionTagView.description: Original strong-reference URI and CID plus the exact referenced vocabulary-tag record view, or null when that version is unavailable.

collectionView.description: Collection record with hydrated author and exact-version location and tag projections. Missing author sidecars are null; unavailable referenced versions retain their source URI and CID with a null record. The original record is unchanged.

tags.description: Projection of record.tags in source order, preserving duplicates. Present as an empty array when record.tags is empty; omitted when it is absent.
